annotations.title: Find the electric utility for a ZIP code

description: Use this first when someone gives a ZIP code and wants electricity plans, rates or to know their electric company. Returns the electric utility for a 5-digit US ZIP code and, in Texas, the delivery company (TDSP). A boundary ZIP code can have more than one: show them all and never pick one. Do not use it for gas utilities, street addresses or non-US postal codes. `status` `no_data_for_scope` means the ZIP code is not in our map, not that it is unserved.
name: electricity_find_utility_by_zip
